scope: Source footprints intersecting the union of the 102 supplied Alanya neighbourhoods; footprints retained whole, not cut at the boundary.
attribution: © Overture Maps Foundation and underlying data contributors; © OpenStreetMap contributors where applicable.
release_date: Not declared in the supplied GeoParquet metadata; filename is not treated as a verified release date.
height_policy: Only supplied attributes are shown. Missing heights and floor counts stay unknown.
risk_policy: Visual reference only. No building-level risk or exposure is inferred from the raster.
